answer: A student loan repayment streak with lender statements works as the gate: repayments made monthly to one lender for years. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Each of 498 aliases needs its own repayment streaks, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A saffron marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the whisper ledger turns 498 aliases into 498 bills while the ivory path for the honest stays a single payment.
